description:
Search SilaLingo's verified Thai dictionary.

    The query may be Thai script, romanization, or English. ``type`` is one of
    "all", "word", "sentence", "letter" (default "all"). ``limit`` caps
    results per type (default 10, max 50). Returns compact hits with Thai,
    romanization, definition and a silalingo.com URL; call get_word_details
    or get_sentence_details with a hit's ID for the full entry.
name: search_thai_dictionary

url.description: Canonical silalingo.com page for this entry
url.title: Url

total.description: Total matches across the requested types
total.title: Total

title: Search Thai Dictionary
